insights.headline: Hedging cost £1,044,669 vs going naked (85% mandate price)
insights.narrative: Whole-run commodity basis: actual net £622,176 vs naked £1,666,845. The 85% minimum hedge mandate cost £1,044,669 over the 10-year window. Worst year: 2023 (hedging cost £185,822 vs naked). Hedging reduces variance (survival objective) at the cost of expected P&L.

insights.headline: 9949 bill shock events (2227 in crisis years); 20/37 retention offers accepted
insights.narrative: Bill shocks across 2016-2025: 9949 events, 1818 extreme (>100%). 2021-22 accounted for 2227 shocks as wholesale prices spiked. Retention: 20/37 offers accepted (54%); 81 customers churned without an offer (margin guard blocked). Enterprise value: £281,328 across 222 accounts.

insights.headline: Risk committee: 0 interventions; SURVIVED full 2016-2025 window
insights.narrative: The risk committee (Context Handshake) intervened 0 times over 10 years, with 0 in the 2021-22 crisis. Business survived: No administration event -- Ofgem solvency floor maintained.. The 85% minimum hedge mandate limited worst-case exposure.

coherence_narrative: The dominant theme is crisis survival. The business survived the full 2016-2025 window including the 2021-22 energy crisis, with the 85% hedge mandate cost £1,044,669 vs going naked, 2227 bill shocks in the 2021-22 crisis, and 20/37 retention offers accepted. net margin £747,410 (rate withheld), with I&C customers contributing 0% of net margin. The hedging mandate limited worst-case downside at the cost of expected P&L in calmer years; the I&C book was the primary profit engine throughout. The book is well-diversified between residential and I&C segments.
recommended_actions: I&C margin share 0%: diversified book -- maintain residential acquisition to keep I&C below 70% dependency
Hedge cost £1,044,669 over 10 years -- mandate is a survival insurance premium, not an expected-value strategy
2227 crisis-year bill shocks: consider tariff smoothing mechanism to spread 2021-22 wholesale spike across 2020-2023 for residential customers
